label: sec:transfer-beta-decay-q-beta-spectral-preamble
html: The second half of the transfer-matrix analysis connects the algebraic counit expansion to the spectral-bridge log-ratio \ln(V_{pp}/V_{nn}). This subsection proves the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta spectral-bridge proposition and the exponential decay bound on the archimedean remainder, evaluates the depth-1 symbolic closed forms, and proves the vanishing of the \beta-decay amplitude at the silver-ratio fixed point. It concludes by relating normal-form observability and negative-deficit confinement to the physical MeV scale E_0 = m_e/\bigl(q_0(q_0-1)(1-\hbar_q^2)\bigr) and the T_{3,5} braid transition visualizer.
